cards.title: CONCEPT
cards.text: Nurse authority VSL for Motilli, mirroring the Nuora Alicia Darling editing system (talking head, proof cut in on the noun, full-frame UGC and science cutaways, hard-edged PIP insets for labels and cards, face bare on authority lines). Script is Brooks's MOT-GLP1-WRONG-ORGAN-NURSE-VSL-TEST, 721 words, VO delivered on Woman Over 30 (eleven_v3 Creative, one take, paced to 3:53). Arc: exact-avatar callout → promise → credential → validation → mechanism → cabinet kill → wrong-organ reveal → absolution → shot-cancellation boundary → three ingredient jobs → Motilli → ordinary morning → 90-day guarantee. APPROVAL GATE: pick the nurse base frame in the moodboard and approve the keyframes on OUR VERSION before the HeyGen render fires.

cards.title: OUR VERSION — MOT-VID-012  ·  Motilli · 3:53 · HeyGen Avatar V + Woman Over 30

cards.text: NOTES

cards.title: DO
cards.text: Image lands ON the word (≤0.5s). Four kinds only: CARD / UGC / SCIENCE full frame, PIP inset only where marked. Real trade dress only. Captions white box, black text, mid-frame at ~52%, 2-4 words, every frame. Red TOP BANNER 0:00-0:07 only. Hard cuts. One continuous VO, never cut.

cards.title: DON'T
cards.text: No insets outside the PIP beats. No generic bottles. No name, badge, employer or credential card for the nurse. No Motilli on screen before 3:11. No shake, zoom drift, dissolves or music. No re-render of the VO.

cards.title: VOICE + PACE
cards.text: Woman Over 30 (instant clone, v3-capable) on eleven_v3 Creative. Raw take 4:44 at 152 wpm; de-paused and atempo 1.2 → 3:53 at ~186 wpm, -14 LUFS. All brand and drug words passed the transcription gate (Motilli, Mounjaro, Ozempic, Wegovy, Zepbound, Miralax, apigenin, chlorophyllin).

cards.title: FLAGS FOR BROOKS
cards.text: 1) The script doc carries its own credential gate (a verified nurse with 25 years in GI care; no invented biography). An AI nurse avatar is your call; the ad keeps her unnamed and adds no biography beyond the spoken line. 2) 11 FACE holds run 4-7s on purpose (authority/boundary lines, as the reference does); every non-face hold is ≤5.5s. 3) Pick the nurse base frame here. Render does not fire until you approve.
